body_markdown:
###


THE OFFICIAL TRAILER FOR


#


THE GOOD BOSS


###


The new series starring Luca Zingaretti


####


COMING ONLY ON NETFLIX ON DECEMBER 2


#####


[TRAILER](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5qGwUB1UBA) |


[KEY ART](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/33c537d9-214d-4f88-b134-bf037d3d6f11) |


[PHOTOS](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/69372815-90ea-45e6-96aa-c10a1363f353)


######


Credits: Camilla Cattabriga/Netflix


The


official trailer


for


The Good Boss,


the new six-episode series starring


Luca Zingaretti


, debuts today. Produced by Cattleya, part of ITV Studios, the series will be available


only on Netflix on December 2


.


Giulio Zagni (Luca Zingaretti) is “the perfect boss”, the undisputed and beloved ruler of his steering wheel factory and his family. Friends, relatives and employees can go off track, because he is always there to fix things, whatever the cost. But when this well-oiled machine breaks down, the professional and family life of this model entrepreneur from Motor Valley suddenly spirals out of control. Between tragicomic twists and turns and strokes of genius, will Giulio manage to get back on track?


The cast also includes


Francesco Colella


,


Giovanni Esposito


,


Alessia Giuliani


,


Carmine Buschini


,


Alberto Boubakar Malanchino


,


Sara Drago


,


Cristina Cappelli


,


Sara Mondello


,


Anna Bisciari


and


Cristina Parku


, with a special appearance by


Nek


, and with


Filippo Tortu


,


Leonardo Manera


,


Raul Cremona


,


Anna Carol


,


Dente


and


Davide Toffolo


as special guests.


The series is written by


Davide Lantieri


(


Murders at Barlume


,


The Wedding Days


),


Michele Pellegrini


(


Imma Tataranni - Deputy Prosecutor


,


The Mafia Kills Only in Summer


), who’s also Head Writer,


Marco Pettenello


(


The Great Ambition


,


Citizens of the World


),


Serena Patrignanelli


(


Electric Rose


) and


Virginia Virilli


(


Bang Bang Baby


).


Roan Johnson


(


Murders at Barlume


,


Piuma


) directs the first three episodes, while


Niccolò Falsetti


(


Hello Cruel World


,


Margins


) directs the final three. The series is based on the film


El Buen Patrón


by


Fernando León de Aranoa


, who also wrote the series concept.


The series is produced with the support of the Emilia-Romagna Region through the Emilia-Romagna Film Commission.
